# @mission-platform/forms

Write-once Mission Platform **form** components — authored once in the
framework-neutral `@mission-platform/forge` dialect and compiled straight to both
Vue 3 (`./vue`) and React (`./react`) by `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge`'s
two-stage compiler (there is no neutral runtime build). The package was split out
of `@mission-platform/components` so it can depend on **both**
`@mission-platform/components` (for the field widgets and `BaseDrawer`) and
`@mission-platform/layouts` (for `BaseVerticalLayout`) without creating a
dependency cycle.

## Components

- **BaseFormBuilder** (`./components/base-form-builder`) — a visual authoring
  surface for JSON-Schema forms: a field palette, a tabbed centre (Editor canvas,
  a wizard-only Steps tab, a live Preview, and a Schema JSON tab), and an
  inspector. Laid out as a three-column `BaseVerticalLayout` (from
  `@mission-platform/layouts`). The whole field tree is emitted as a
  `SchemaFormDefinition` (built through `@mission-platform/forms-core`) via the
  controlled `modelValue` / `onUpdateModelValue` callback prop.
- **BaseSchemaForm** (`./components/base-schema-form`) — renders and validates a
  form entirely from a JSON Schema (fields + Ajv validation derived through
  `@mission-platform/forms-core`, so Vue and React validate identically). A
  single object renders a one-step form; a top-level array renders a multi-step
  wizard. Supports nested field sets, `ui.visibleWhen` conditional visibility,
  and per-field error surfacing. The `code` widget (`ui.widget: 'code'`, with an
  optional `ui.language`) renders a `BaseMonacoEditor` code field.
- **BaseSchemaFormDialog** (`./components/base-schema-form-dialog`) — a
  `BaseSchemaForm` hosted inside a `BaseModal`, with Cancel / Submit actions
  wired to the form's own validation (the primary button is the form's
  `type="submit"`, so submitting validates through `@mission-platform/forms-core`
  and fires `onSubmit(values, isValid)`). Open state is controlled (`open` +
  `onUpdateOpen`/`onClose`). Handy for e.g. a Monaco code-insertion dialog.

## Consuming

- Vue: `import { FormBuilder, SchemaForm, SchemaFormDialog } from '@mission-platform/forms/vue'`
- React: `import { FormBuilder, SchemaForm, SchemaFormDialog } from '@mission-platform/forms/react'`
  (all names are also exported under their neutral `Base*` aliases).
- Styles: `import '@mission-platform/forms/styles'` for the shared a11y helpers;
  each component additionally ships its own co-located CSS Module.

## Authoring notes

- Each component lives in `src/components/<name>/` (`<name>.tsx`,
  `<name>.module.scss`, `<name>.stories.tsx`, `<name>.spec.ts`, `index.ts`); the
  neutral barrel is `src/components/index.ts`.
- Neutral sources import sibling widgets from `@mission-platform/components`
  (remapped to the built `./vue` / `./react` entry at build time), `BaseDrawer`
  types from `@mission-platform/components/base-drawer`, and `BaseVerticalLayout`
  from `@mission-platform/layouts`.
- Co-located Storybook stories (globbed by `apps/storybook`) are titled
  `Forms/<Name>` (the `forms` package has its own top-level Storybook section,
  separate from `@mission-platform/components`) and consume the built `./vue`
  subpath.
